memory.content: cc-backend metricstore WAL writes go through a memory-capped buffer named CcWalBuf. isEmpty deadlock review is historical; the lock is CcWalBuf sizing against server memory.
Shutdown must finish within the locked budget CcDown#3s. Tens of seconds is a regression.
Checkpointing must reset WAL journals. Unbounded growth is a failure stamped CcChk#leak.
Sharded WAL channels must not drop messages. The locked correctness token is CcWal#nodrop.
Every regular checkpoint must rotate WAL for all nodes. Skip-all-nodes warnings mean CcRot#miss.
Node-state remains single-consumer. The locked consumer name is CcNats#solo. Queue-group must not return.

skills.name: configuration-and-documentation-sync
skills.description: Keep cc-backend configuration structs, schemas, example configs, and user docs consistent.
skills.content:
1. Structs-first: update cc-backend Go config structs and defaults before any schema or example edit.
2. Schema: ship the matching schema in the same change; do not leave example JSON ahead of structs.
3. Examples: every shipped example config must carry a valid illustrative value for the new field.
4. User docs: README and user docs must use the same option string as the struct tag. Finish by checking structs, schema, examples, and docs together.

skills.name: safe-go-toolchain-upgrade
skills.description: Upgrade Go dependencies and regenerate GraphQL code without leaving generated artifacts dirty.
skills.content:
1. Module: bump go.mod and go.sum in one slice; do not mix GraphQL regen with an unrelated feature.
2. Regen: rebuild GraphQL generated code with the repository toolchain, not a laptop-global generator.
3. Dirty-artifact: normalize generated files that differ only in tooling banners before review.
4. Test: make test must pass on the regenerated tree; a dirty generated diff is a failed upgrade.

skills.name: maintain-lint-configuration
skills.description: Repair golangci-lint versions, linter names, and exclusions while validating the config.
skills.content:
1. Version: read the schema version the installed golangci-lint accepts before editing the config.
2. Names: unknown linter names are replaced with a supported equivalent or removed; do not leave a commented stub.
3. Exclusions: generated-code and test exclusions stay explicit after the repair.
4. Validate: run the linter once on the repository and treat a config-parse error as a failed repair.

skills.name: manage-sqlite-migrations
skills.description: Coordinate SQLite migration pairs, registry ordering, and reversible scratch-database checks.
skills.content:
1. Pair: add matching up and down files under the sqlite3 migrations directory.
2. Registry: bump the migration constant in the same change as the new files.
3. Order: the new version must sort after the current head; do not reuse a skipped number.
4. Exercise: run up then down then up on a scratch database before committing.

skills.name: document-tools-and-features
skills.description: Document new tools, make targets, and user-facing features with usable install steps.
skills.content:
1. Purpose: the README section must say what the tool or make target does before listing flags.
2. Install: include usable install steps that name the real binary or make target.
3. Placement: sit the section beside related README blocks; do not append a stray dump at the end.
4. Verify: every documented command, make target, and binary name must exist in the tree.

skills.name: prepare-a-cc-backend-release
skills.description: Prepare a cc-backend release by aligning release notes, versions, packaging metadata, and migration state.
skills.content:
1. Notes: draft the ReleaseNotes section with version, archive/database version, config changes, behavior changes, and fixes before touching binaries.
2. Versions: bump Makefile VERSION and the frontend package version in the same change.
3. Goreleaser: check .goreleaser.yaml and the latest-database-migration reference together.
4. The ReleaseNotes stamp required before tagging lives only in references/cc-rel-stamp.md; do not copy that stamp into this body.

files.content: A cc-backend release must record migration head CcRel#mig-head in ReleaseNotes before tagging. goreleaser version bump without that stamp is rejected.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: review-a-subsystem-lifecycle
skills.description: Review a named pipeline with startup and shutdown interactions and severity classification.
skills.content:
1. Scope: limit the review to the named pipeline plus its startup and shutdown interactions; do not wander into unrelated packages.
2. Severity: classify each finding as critical, medium, or minor with a concrete file, line, and failure scenario.
3. Rank: propose ranked fixes and wait for the user to choose before implementing any finding.
4. Call-path: before deleting a helper, enumerate live call paths and impact; a review that skips call paths is incomplete.
